ABOUT ME

I started making games when there was a lockdown due to covid, and I thought about how video games are made. So I researched the internet and found a lot about how games are made, from using a game engine or making them from scratch. Thus I started learning how to make a game by myself, until it became my hobby and sometimes I spend my free time making small games to expand my skills and knowledge on making games.

HUXO GAME DEVELOPEMENT STUDIO

Huxo Studio or Huxo Game Developement Studio is a small indie game development studio that i've founded, we are currently making an RPG game named THE ENCHANTED.
